folder_note: order 1.1 allows only v1-folder/addendum2/; order 6 'tables/addendum2/' is read relative to it (same as addendum 1). The config path is the one the order names (1.3).

places.inherit: configs/phd/main_trainerr_v1/addendum1.json places (south_wall, long_wall with the fitted long-wall shift of addendum1 long_wall_fit.json, annex_roof_edge, back_wall_bottom), unchanged

annex_under.rule: trained result samples of the arm (own FINALTRAIN_30000, gt A1) with x, y in the box, result case_id 2, eligible_new, finite s_m and |s_m| > 1.0 m (s_m = stored result-to-reference normal distance)

common.model: arm 30000 model: own FINALTRAIN ft_<prior>_s0 attempt1, gt GTJUDGE gt_<prior>_s0 (B0_b10__LoD2 attempt2, others attempt1); per-Gaussian fields from target_monitor/snapshot_30000.npz (same rows and values as point_cloud/iteration_30000/point_cloud.ply: xyz equal, sigmoid(opacity) equal; checked for B0_b10__LoD2 both arms)

spot_gaussians.distance: 3D distance from the Gaussian centre to the spot

states.same_patch: target_tag 1 and bound patch (patch_ids[target_index]) == the point's column patch

common.column_patch: GT rows: rows.npz row_owner -> JUDGEAPPLY core_points source_index (target row); result samples: s0_sets.columns on the stored result xyz (A1: GTJUDGE distances/A1_samples.npz owner); kept only when the target row is a valid patch (valid_patch)

born_kind.seed_or_child: seed = rows before the first row whose init_id does not increase (original rows stay first and in init order; densification appends); child = the rest
born_kind.validation: record runs (TRAINERR r28 trainlog states 30000, true born_at): all seeds precede all children in full index order and the prefix length equals the true seed count (B0 LoD2 own 5712 = 5712)

common.size: max of the two activated scales
common.visibility: not used (order 0.2); work 다 uses only 'inside the image' (no occlusion)
common.judgment_source: targets judge_region of the column patch before validity filtering (own: FINALTRAIN targets/<stem>.npz, gt: GTJUDGE targets_gt/<stem>.npz)
common.patch_case: modal stage1 case_id of the patch's GT rows (ties: smaller case, addendum1 rule); no GT rows -> -1 '없음'

work_ga.maps: training target maps the run read (jbgs_target.py maps: own FINALTRAIN stage1/<stem>/maps, gt GTJUDGE stage1/<stem>/maps; keys depth, sigma, weight, owner; 1024 x 741 training camera K and W2C from maps/index.json)
work_ga.target_pixels: owner >= 0; target depth = maps depth there (exact target-disc camera depth, prepare_maps_r7.draw)

image_depth.after_mask: same where finite, > 0 and conf > 0 (fork_inputs maps/conf) = the rule prepare_inputs uses to put MVS depth into background pixels

classes.behind: image depth > target depth + 1.0 m (order: 함께 적는다)

work_ga.split: scene x arm x patch case; B0_b10__LoD2 also by place: south_wall / long_wall = patches whose target centre lies in the addendum1 zone with |d| <= 1 m (addendum1 4.4 rule), other = the rest

patch_front_bins.value: front pixels / target pixels of the patch over all training views (patches with no target pixel excluded and counted)
patch_front_bins.outcome: per bin: trained wrong result point share = sum patch_trained_far / sum patch_trained_n, target share the same with patch_target_* (addendum1 work 라 ra/<stem>__<arm>.npz, order addendum1 6.3)

work_ga.patch_values_check: applied views and supervision per patch recomputed from the same maps and compared with addendum1 ra patch_applied_views / patch_supervision

qualitative.images: DJI_20241217094933_0013_D, DJI_20241217093905_0026_D and the three training images with most target pixels owned by south-wall patches in the own arm maps (excluding the two; ties smaller name); the gt arm's top three are reported
qualitative.camera_crop: addendum1 work 가: full-resolution FULL_OPENCV camera, GTJUDGE addendum9 undistort_crop to 1600 x 1280 pinhole, crop = bounds_crop around the south-wall zone corners (place_corners south_wall) projected with the full camera
qualitative.map_sampling: each output pixel ray (crop pinhole) -> training camera of the map (map K, W2C rotation; rotation difference to the full camera reported) -> pixel floor(u + 0.5) (v1 rule); nearest sample, no interpolation

panels.목표깊이: maps depth at owner >= 0 (target pixels only)
panels.영상깊이_후: MVS depth after the conf mask
panels.출처: owner patch kind (LoD2 wall kind 2 / roof) x patch case colour; MVS background pixel grey; no target dark
panels.차이: target depth - raw MVS depth, diverging -3..+3 m; target pixel without MVS depth #FFD700; no target white

qualitative.depth_colour: same colour range for the three depth panels of one image: 2-98 % of the target depths inside the crop
qualitative.arms: target-dependent panels (목표깊이, 출처, 차이) for own and gt; photo and MVS panels once

south_behind.rule: addendum1 4.2: trained result samples in the south-wall zone, eligible_new, not within tau, d < -0.64

south_face.rule: trained result samples in the south-wall zone, eligible_new, within tau (control)

long_face.rule: trained result samples in the long-wall zone (fitted shift), eligible_new, within tau (control)

annex_control.rule: trained result samples with case_id 2, eligible_new, within tau, whole scene (control)

edge_wrong.rule: v1 sets c1_<arm>_lost: spot = X + s n (trained_s_m; X + s n lies on the trained mesh, median 0.02-0.03 m); no finite s -> '면 없음' (counted, no spot)

edge_control.rule: v1 sets c1_<arm>_control, spot = X + s n

floor_wrong.rule: v1 sets c2_<arm>_lost, spot = X + s n

floor_control.rule: v1 sets c2_<arm>_control, spot = X + s n

work_na.gt_spot: nearest GT reference row (addendum11 final_data reference__xyz of the stem) to the spot; for edge/floor sets the lost/control GT point itself; gaussians within 0.2 m of that row (same rules)
work_na.values: state distribution by count and by opacity sum, share of spots with no Gaussian, opacity and size quantiles (10/25/50/75/90), born kind, bound target |h| and band, the same for the GT spot; distance spot -> GT spot

south.horizontal: z in [-38, -34.5], (a, d) with a in [0, 20], d in [-5, 2]; mesh lines cut at z = -36.25
south.colours: bound to a south-wall patch (addendum1 4.4 zone rule), bound to another patch, released, background; marker size by opacity; GT rows grey, target mesh and trained mesh section lines

annex.vertical: y = 1.7 +/- 0.25 m (through the addendum1 annex_roof_edge centre), x in [84, 100], z in [-44, -31]
annex.colours: bound to a patch whose target lies in the annex_under box, bound to another patch, released, background

work_da.points: annex_under of the own arm (all points)
work_da.inside: projects inside the full-resolution image with camera z > 0 (no occlusion test; recorded in every json)

groups.수직에 가까움: angle between point-to-camera direction and the stored result normal <= 30 deg (addendum1 facing rule)

work_da.select: per group the training image with most inside points; ties smaller name
work_da.crop: bounds_crop around the projections of the box: annex_under x, y bounding box +/- 5 m, z from the points' min to their max + 4 m (the roof is 2.6-3.8 m above)

panels.점: annex_under points of the arm (#D62728) drawn when inside
panels.렌더: arm 30000 model RGB render at the crop pinhole camera (1600 x 1280), inherited renderer (te_render), model cropped to the views box, black background

work_ra.points: addendum11 final_data reference rows (eligible) of the stem; target within = reference__<judgment_mesh|gt_judgment_mesh>__within_tau1 (addendum11), trained within = own reference__FINALTRAIN_30000__within_tau1 (addendum11), gt reference__A1__within_tau1 (addendum12 distance_A1); > 300000 -> random 300000 (seed 20261112)

values.target_distance: (X - target[patch]) . normal[patch] of the valid column patch
values.applied_views: patch target applied views (0.3; maps owner)
values.supervision: sum of the patch's map weights / patch area (0.3)
values.bound: count of Gaussians bound to the patch at 30000, max opacity, initial patch seeds (seeds.npz origin 1, patch)
values.gt_spot: Gaussians within 0.2 m of the point (common rules): state counts, opacity max and sum, none

work_ra.applied_view_bins: quintile edges of the points' patch applied views pooled over all scenes and arms (ties merged); points without a valid patch their own bin
comparisons: case 1: 고침 vs 둘 다 틀림
case 2 and case 4: 잃음 vs 지킴
work_ra.figures: per scene x arm top view, the four groups coloured (지킴 grey, 잃음 blue, 고침 green, 둘 다 틀림 red)

points_files: npz per work in the payload addendum2/points/; > 200 MB -> random subsample (recorded)
